files.מספר תיק פיקוח: kpi:files — key: one inspection file per row
files.ישות מפוקחת: skip: free-text description of the inspected place; some rows name a private complainant ("תלונת <name> על ..."), so the page never quotes it — type and town carry the comparable information
files.סוג הישות המפוקחת: chart-family, chart-mix, chart-etype, chart-complaints, chart-building, map-main, insight:type, insight:building, insight:city — 93 raw types grouped into broad families by keyword, unknown types fall to אחר
files.תאריך ושעת פיקוח: chart-yearly, chart-mix, chart-heat, chart-weekday, map-main, kpi:latest, insight:latest, insight:peak, insight:trend, insight:month
files.הערות לכתובת: skip: free-text address remarks, 95% empty, includes an email address
files.קואורדינטות רוחב: skip: WGS84 latitude; a few rows have lat/lon swapped — the map uses the ITM pair, whose sanity check drops those rows
files.קואורדינטות אורך: skip: WGS84 longitude, same reason as the latitude
files.כתובת אתר האינטרנט: skip: URL of the inspected website, 96% empty
